name: log-card-look
description: Structured log, probe 2 of looks loaded from the card: at the first flush of a session (the GUI enters a menu, playback or the power-off state) the flush task reads the first 32 bytes of C:\EPM2LOOK.BIN and writes card_read (bytes read, -1 when the file did not open; bytes 0-3). When the file has 26 bytes or more and starts with LOOK, its bytes 8-25 (9 x s16) are written into the art matrix of codes 71 and 80 (Pro 400H) at 0x7ECB0988, through the cached address and its uncached alias, and card_look gives the number of values written and values 0 and 1 read back from RAM. The colour stage that reads the table runs on CPU 1. Then the flush runs as before. One hook at the flush task's entry (log-core's code) and two routines in free runs of segment 2. In place of log-card-read, on the specs of data/builds/debug-log-films-12d.json. It puts the build id f412b3f66f1c1b6b of data/logdict/events.json into the block header. DEBUG builds only. See experiments/2026-11-17-card-looks/NOTES.md.
_ram: 1 byte of the log's state block (PST+104); the flush task's block buffer for the read

ops._note: hook (card_read): jmp T_CRD. the flush task's entry (log-core): `movm [d2,d3,a2,a3],(sp)` / `add -64,sp`; task USRTEST_A, started by T_GUI when the GUI enters a menu, playback or the power-off state
flush task, block header: build id bytes 0-3 da49b2f5 -> f412b3f6 (data/logdict/events.json)
flush task, block header: build id bytes 4-7 e7e62ca7 -> 6f1c1b6b (data/logdict/events.json)
